lines.japanese: 「あーっ！　隼人くん見っけー！」
lines.english: “Oh! I found you, Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「やっば、ちょーど良かったかも。いま私、めっちゃ暇しててぇー。ねーねー、どっか遊び行かん？」
lines.english: “Wow, perfect timing. I’m, like, insanely bored right now. Hey, wanna go do something?”

lines.japanese: どの俺が返事をしますか？
lines.english: Which of us will answer?

lines.japanese: 「無理」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 俺は二、三歩さがりながら無愛想に答えた。
lines.english: I answered curtly while backing away two or three steps.

lines.japanese: 香田亜衣。俺に対しては放っとけば前へ前へと詰めてくるやつだから、このぐらいが適正な距離だと思う。
lines.english: Ai Kouda. Left alone, she would keep pressing closer and closer to me, so this seemed like the right distance.

lines.japanese: 「俺、忙しンだよ。あのうぜえロンゲとか、鳳ンとこの連中に遊んでもらえよ」
lines.english: “I’m busy. Go play with that annoying longhair or the people at Ohtori’s place.”

lines.japanese: あれ。
lines.english: Huh.

lines.japanese: 例によってギャーギャーわめくのかと思ったが、香田は目を丸くした間抜けヅラで黙りこんでしまった──
lines.english: I expected her to start screeching like usual, but Kouda just went quiet, staring at me with a dumb, wide-eyed look—

lines.japanese: 「あはっ」
lines.english: “Ah-ha!”

lines.japanese: ──と思ったら笑った。
lines.english: —then she laughed.

lines.japanese: 「んーだよ。男の子の顔見ていきなり笑ってんじゃねえよ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “What? Don’t laugh the second you see a guy’s face. I’ll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは……懐かしいなって思って、隼人君がそういうブスッとしたクチ利くの。最近なんかテンション高めだったじゃん」
lines.english: “Ha-ha... I was feeling nostalgic. It’s been a while since you talked all grumpy like that, Hayato. You’ve been kind of hyper lately.”

lines.japanese: まァ、アレは俺であって俺じゃなかったからな。つーか、次会うときはまたアレに戻ってるだろうけど。戻ってなきゃ困る。
lines.english: Well, that had been me and not me. Besides, the next time we met, I’d probably be back like that. I’d be in trouble if I wasn’t.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとね、気ぃ遣わせちゃってんのかなーとか、引っかかってたんだけど」
lines.english: “It had been bothering me a little. I thought maybe I made you feel like you had to act different around me.”

lines.japanese: ひと月半ほど前、俺は香田から有難い気持ちを打ちあけられた──
lines.english: About a month and a half ago, Kouda had told me how she felt—

lines.japanese: ──が、受けいれることはできなかった。
lines.english: —but I could not accept those feelings.

lines.japanese: 俺たちが≪統合≫を果たしたのは、思えばその直後だった。
lines.english: Come to think of it, our *integration* had happened right afterward.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね」
lines.english: “I’m sorry.”

lines.japanese: いや、おまえが謝るこっちゃねえよ。
lines.english: You had nothing to apologize for.

lines.japanese: 「よかった……あはっ、ありがと」
lines.english: “I’m glad... Ah-ha. Thank you.”

lines.japanese: いや、礼を言うことでもねえし、ましてやそんな若干涙目になるこっちゃねえんだって。
lines.english: You didn’t need to thank me either, much less get tears in your eyes over it.

lines.japanese: 「関係ねーよ。べつに、今日はちょっと具合悪くてやる気ねーだけ。今度会うときは──」
lines.english: “It’s got nothing to do with you. I just feel like crap today and can’t be bothered. The next time we meet—”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、平気！？　もしかインフル？」
lines.english: “What? Are you okay?! Is it the flu?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、いや、体の方は全然。そう、だから、今度会うときはもう戻ってるかも──」
lines.english: “Oh, no, I feel fine physically. So like I said, the next time we meet I might be back—”

lines.japanese: 「よかったぁ。隼人君、ちょっとぐらいの病気じゃ音ぇ上げなそーだもん。よっぽど重いのかと思った」
lines.english: “Thank goodness. You seem like you wouldn’t complain about a little sickness, Hayato, so I thought it must be really serious.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そう……」
lines.english: “Right. Sure...”

lines.japanese: 事情が明かせないとはいえ、適当にでっちあげた嘘で気を揉ませるのは居たたまれない。俺は頭を下げるように靴と地面を睨んだ。
lines.english: I couldn’t tell her the truth, but making her worry over a lie I’d invented on the spot felt awful. I dropped my head and glared at my shoes and the ground.

lines.japanese: 「でも罹りかけがいちばん気を抜くなって、だっちーの横の眼鏡が言ってたよ。隼人君、こんなとこウロウロしてないで早く帰りなって」
lines.english: “But the guy with glasses next to Dacchi said the very start is when you have to be most careful. Stop wandering around and go home, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おう。そうだな。でも──」
lines.english: “Y-yeah. You’re right. But—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そっか！　ごめん、私から声かけたンじゃんねえ？　ごめんごめん、急いでるとこ足止めさせちゃって。早く早く！　家帰って布団かぶって寝て！」
lines.english: “Oh, right! Sorry, I’m the one who stopped you, aren’t I? Sorry, sorry! I held you up when you were in a hurry. Go, go! Get home, get under the covers, and sleep!”

lines.japanese: 「おう、ちょっと待てって。その前に──」
lines.english: “Yeah, wait a second. Before that—”

lines.japanese: 「そんで、元気になったらまた遊んでねっ」
lines.english: “And when you feel better, hang out with me again!”

lines.japanese: 「おう、そうだな、そんで──」
lines.english: “Yeah, sure, and—”

lines.japanese: いや、待て俺。そうだなじゃねーだろ。誘われて軽はずみな返事してんじゃねーよ。
lines.english: Wait. No. Not “sure.” Don’t give a careless answer just because she asked.

lines.japanese: 仮にも相手は、俺に気があるって公言してるやつだ。気を持たせる方が結果的には残酷だろう。そこはちゃんと断ってやるべきだ。それが突きはなす優しさってもんだ。
lines.english: She had openly said she had feelings for me. Giving her hope would only be cruel in the end. I had to refuse her clearly. Sometimes kindness meant pushing somebody away.

lines.japanese: つってもなァ……そんな展開行っちゃったら、ちょっと署名なんて頼みにくい空気になるだろ。
lines.english: But if the conversation went that way, it would get pretty hard to ask for a signature.

lines.japanese: じゃあまず署名をしてもらってから断るか。すみません名前書いてください、ところであなたとは親しくなれません。いやいや、それもおかしいだろ。
lines.english: Should I get her signature first, then reject her? “Excuse me, please write your name. By the way, we can’t be close.” No, that was insane too.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあねー隼人くん、お大事にー！」
lines.english: “Bye, Hayato! Take care!”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　あァ、ありがとな──」
lines.english: “Huh? Yeah. Thanks—”

lines.japanese: 「──って、もういねえじゃねえか。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “—She’s gone already. I’ll fucking kill her.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃっほう！　いつもお誘いありがとーう！」
lines.english: “Yahoo! Thank you for always inviting me!”

lines.japanese: 「でも残念！　今日は俺ちょっと用事あって付きあえないの！　また今度誘ってね！」
lines.english: “But I’m sorry! I’ve got something to do today, so I can’t join you! Ask me again sometime!”

lines.japanese: 「うん、分かった。てゆか隼人君、珍しくテンションバリ高じゃん。なに、なんかイイことあった？」
lines.english: “Okay! Wait, Hayato, you’re, like, super hyper today. What happened? Something good?”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、そーでもないんだけどさ、いっつも仏頂面してたってしょーがないでしょ」
lines.english: “Not really, but there’s no point going around scowling all the time.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、分かる！　だよね！　イイコトないときこそ、せめて気持ちぐらいは明るく行きたいよねー！」
lines.english: “Oh, I get it! Exactly! When nothing good is happening, that’s when you’ve gotta at least keep your spirits bright!”

lines.japanese: 「でっしょお！？　空の色は自分次第だもんねえ、とりあえず笑っとかなきゃどんどん暗くなる一方だよねえ！」
lines.english: “Right?! The color of the sky is up to you! If you don’t at least keep smiling, it’ll only get darker and darker!”

lines.japanese: 「だよねだよね！　だって、ひとり暗いとみんな暗くなっちゃうじゃん？　自分のせいで周りまで暗くしちゃうとか、そんなんヤじゃない！？」
lines.english: “Right, right! When one person gets gloomy, everybody gets gloomy, you know? Who wants to drag everyone else down with them?!”

lines.japanese: 「マーベラス！　打たれても踏まれてもお陽様に向かって咲く、ヒマワリのような少女！　いよっ、サンフラワー香田！　素晴らしい！　素晴らしいついでに、ちょっとここに署名プリーズ！」
lines.english: “Marvelous! A maiden like a sunflower, forever blooming toward the sun no matter how she’s struck or trampled! Behold, Sunflower Kouda! Splendid! And while you’re being splendid, please sign right here!”

lines.japanese: 「イェス！　おっけてぃんぐ任しときー！　香、田、亜、衣……つってネーム・フォー・ユー！」
lines.english: “Yes! Okie-dokie, leave it to me! Ai, Kou, da... and that’s a name for you!”

lines.japanese: 「あざーっす、ご芳名いただきましたー！」
lines.english: “Thank you! One illustrious name received!”

lines.japanese: なんか勢いであっけなく任務を遂行してしまいました。
lines.english: Somehow, sheer momentum made the mission effortless.

lines.japanese: これぞ世に云う、笑う門には福きたるってやつですかね。
lines.english: Perhaps this was what people meant when they said fortune comes to a laughing home.

lines.japanese: 「でも私の場合、ヘコむ理由ってたいがい隼人君絡みなんだよねー」
lines.english: “Though in my case, when I get depressed, it’s usually because of you.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はは……いや、ほら、笑顔っすよ笑顔……」
lines.english: “Ha-ha... Well, remember the smile. Keep smiling...”

lines.japanese: 「あははっ、そだね。じゃあ、次はマジで付きあってよ。約束だかんね」
lines.english: “Ah-ha! You’re right. But seriously, come with me next time. Promise, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ええ、もちろん……」
lines.english: “Yes, of course...”

lines.japanese: 機会があれば？
lines.english: If the opportunity arose?

lines.japanese: 「次の約束があるってイイよね。へへ、その間ずーっとハピれるんだもん」
lines.english: “It’s nice having a promise for next time. Hee-hee. I can stay happy the whole time I’m waiting.”

lines.japanese: 「は、ははは……」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha...”

lines.japanese: 機会、あるかなあ……。
lines.english: Would the opportunity arise...?

lines.japanese: 「ふむん、遊びとな」
lines.english: “Hm. Thou speakest of play.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　なにその喋り方」
lines.english: “What? Why are you talking like that?”

lines.japanese: 「ちと尋ねるが、うぬら市井の民草は、日頃いかな遊戯に興じるのだ。余は誇り高き王家の直系なれば、下々の俗事に明るくないゆえ」
lines.english: “I would ask thee this: in what games do common folk such as you amuse yourselves? As the proud scion of the royal line, I know little of the diversions of the lower orders.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃはは！　ええ～、何なんソレ？　だっさ～、翔さんに対抗してキャラ作ってみた系？」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! What is that? So lame! Did you invent a character to compete with Kakeru?”

lines.japanese: 「ばふん！　聞いておるのは我ぞ、早よう其の方の申す遊びとやらを述べよ！」
lines.english: “Bafun! I am the one asking questions! Make haste and describe this ‘play’ of which thou speakest!”

lines.japanese: 「今度はキレ芸？　なんか面倒くさいキャラだなあ……」
lines.english: “Now angry shouting is part of the act? What a pain in the ass...”

lines.japanese: 「遊びったって、フツーに会ってブラブラしたり、食べたり喋ったりするくらいじゃん」
lines.english: “I just mean hanging out. You know, meeting up, walking around, eating, talking.”

lines.japanese: 「なに、それだけと申すか」
lines.english: “What? Is that all?”

lines.japanese: 「うっさいな、お金かかる系の遊びはそうそう毎んち出来ないの。そっちだってそうじゃん、いっつも拾った雑誌読んだり、階段座ってボーッとしたりしてるだけじゃん」
lines.english: “Shut up. We can’t do stuff that costs money every day. You’re the same. All you do is read magazines you found or sit on the stairs staring into space.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そか。だからいま変な痛キャラ作って遊んでんだ？　や～る、エコいねっ」
lines.english: “Oh, I get it. So you made this weird, cringey character to entertain yourself? Wow, so eco-friendly!”

lines.japanese: 「るふう、下賎の民が戯れ言を申すわ。我が氏はやんごとなき際にあれば、幼少のみぎりには、伝説の龍騎士にならい仔ヒドラの背に跨ったり、燃えさかる火炎弾を懸けて闘技場を駆けまわったりしたものよ」
lines.english: “Hrrfoo. The vulgar rabble speaks nonsense. My bloodline is exalted. In my youth, I rode upon the backs of infant hydras after the legendary dragon knights and raced through the arena in pursuit of blazing fireballs.”

lines.japanese: 「やっばー、男の子ワケワカラン。そんなんして遊んでたの？」
lines.english: “Wow. Boys make no sense. You played like that?”

lines.japanese: 「今の昔はな」
lines.english: “In the former days of now.”

lines.japanese: 「今の昔？　って、どゆこと？」
lines.english: “The former days of now? What does that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「どうもこうもあるまい、チャンネル７７７に限っての過去という意味だ。俺の≪精髄≫がこの次元にフォーカスする以前の、膨大な≪置いてきた記憶≫にまで言及してしまうと≪森羅の理≫を侵しかねんからな」
lines.english: “What else could it mean? The past belonging solely to Channel 777. If I spoke even of the vast *memories left behind* from before my *essence* focused upon this dimension, I might violate the *Principle of All Creation*.”

lines.japanese: 「あっはっはっ！　超じゃん、超イミフ！　まじウケるし。そのキャラ一周まわって逆にアリかも」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! That’s incredible! I have no idea what you’re saying! This character might be so awful it loops back around to good.”

lines.japanese: 「はぽん！？　娘よ、一周まわると申したか。畏れいったぞ、よもや≪多元式相対輪廻≫の概念を心得ていたとはな。近次元での貴様はさぞかし≪位相大脳≫の≪エーテル腺受容体≫を≪帯域拡張≫していたのだろう」
lines.english: “Hapon?! Girl, didst thou say it loops back around? I am awed. To think thou hast grasped the concept of *Multiversal Relative Reincarnation*. Thy counterpart in a nearby dimension must have *expanded the bandwidth* of the *aether-gland receptors* in thy *phase cerebrum*.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ～……すっご、そーゆーの全部自分で考えたん？」
lines.english: “Wow... Did you make all of that up yourself?”

lines.japanese: 「うぉんむ、うぉんむ。あるチャンネルでは、生きとし生けるものすべての≪本質≫が≪大いなるひとつ≫として共にあった。俺はその折に≪森羅の理≫をひもとき、世界の構造を余すことなく理解したのだ」
lines.english: “Hrrm, hrrm. In one channel, the *essences* of every living creature existed together as the *Great One*. It was there that I deciphered the *Principle of All Creation* and understood the structure of the world in its entirety.”

lines.japanese: 「話せば長くなるのだが、まあよかろう。そもそも我々の肉体がいま在る、この大宇宙マクロコスモスの始まりは──」
lines.english: “The tale is long, but very well. The beginning of this great macrocosm in which our bodies now reside—”

lines.japanese: 私は≪位相大脳≫から溢れだす≪置いてきた記憶≫を、可能なかぎり出力して（もっとも７７７のいかなる言語を駆使しようとすべて翻訳しきることは到底不可能なのですが）娘に聞かせてやった。
lines.english: I conveyed to the girl as many of the *memories left behind* overflowing from my *phase cerebrum* as I could output—although no language of 777 could possibly translate them all.

lines.japanese: 最初こそ手を叩いて笑っていた彼女だったが、そのうちに反応が淡泊になってゆき、やがては欠伸を噛みころす仕草まで見せるようになった。
lines.english: At first she clapped and laughed. Gradually, however, her reactions grew faint, until at last she began suppressing yawns.

lines.japanese: むろん言うまでもなくこれはダイアル７４．２ＭＨにおけるドブライオンの求愛行動である。おそらく私の話に種としての根源を揺さぶられ、優秀な個を残すための濃密な交配を求めているのだろう。
lines.english: Needless to say, this was the mating display of the Dobrion on Dial 74.2 MHz. My tale had likely shaken her at the root of her species and awakened a desire for vigorous copulation to produce superior offspring.

lines.japanese: だがすでにダイアル８４．２ＭＨにおいて≪左上太陽≫のほろぼろしき御光を知ってしまった私の≪トゥルース≫においては、たかが哺乳類の牝などもはや≪トゥギャザー≫の対象にすらなり得なかった。
lines.english: But my *truth* had already known the crumbling radiance of the *Upper-Left Sun* on Dial 84.2 MHz. A mere mammalian female could no longer qualify as an object of *togetherness*.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ママから電話だー。じゃあ隼人君、私もう行くね。ばいすー」
lines.english: “Oh, Mom’s calling. Okay, Hayato, I’m leaving. Bye-bye!”

lines.japanese: 「なに？　待て娘、話はここからが佳境だぞ。あるチャンネルでの俺は、絶えず肉壁に圧搾され続ける何かだったのだが、その肉壁がおよそ一万年に一度粘度を帯びるゆえ少なからず座標軸の揺らぎが発生し──」
lines.english: “What? Wait, girl! The tale is only now reaching its climax. In one channel, I was some thing forever compressed by walls of flesh. Those walls grew viscous once every ten thousand years, producing a nontrivial fluctuation in the coordinate axes—”

lines.japanese: 「──るふう、行ってしもうたか」
lines.english: “—Hrrfoo. She has gone.”

lines.japanese: 「だが責めはすまい。マクロコスモス全球から見れば、所詮このチャンネルの自我たちは≪進化のあけぼの≫に過ぎぬ。ヒトという発展途上の種が≪森羅の理≫へ≪接続≫するには、もう数億年の時を要すであろう」
lines.english: “Yet I shall not condemn her. On the global scale of the macrocosm, the egos of this channel are merely the *dawn of evolution*. The developing species called humanity will require several hundred million more years to *connect* with the *Principle of All Creation*.”

lines.japanese: 「我らは先達として、いましばらくあの≪遅れた友人たち≫を陰から見守ってやろうではないか。うぉんむ、うぉんむ」
lines.english: “As their forebear, We shall watch over those *belated friends* from the shadows a while longer. Hrrm, hrrm.”

lines.japanese: ところで、いま私の手に握られた、この署名用紙なる≪低階層物質≫は何であろう。とんと思いだせない。
lines.english: Incidentally, what was this *lower-stratum matter* called a petition sheet that I now held in my hand? I could not remember in the least.
